name: Tavily
credit_unit: 1 credit; basic search = 1 credit, advanced search = 2 credits

credits.crawl_note: crawl cost = mapping cost + extraction cost, i.e. 0.1 credit per page mapped + 0.2 credit per page extracted at basic depth = 0.3 credit per page

notes: Credits reset on the first day of the calendar month, not the billing anniversary.
If monthly credits are exhausted, requests stop until reset or upgrade — the plan page says so; PAYG is the overage mechanism on the PAYG plan, not a blanket fallback on a monthly plan.
